title: AS2 compiler: switch fall-through broken — wrong AVM1 stack behavior
description: In packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts lines 1008-1009, switch case fall-through is silently broken. When a case body does NOT end with break, execution falls through to the next case's comparison block (ActionDuplicate/push/ActionEquals2), but the discriminant was already popped when that case was entered. The comparison then operates on garbage. Fix: after each case body that falls through (no break), emit a jump that skips the next case's comparison block and goes directly to the next case's body. This matches AVM1 switch semantics.
